risk.rationale: Verified evidence forms a confirmed account takeover chain: F1 delivers a typosquat DocuSign phishing lure (T1566.002) as initial access; F3/F4 confirm zero-MFA session sign-in from AS16276 OVH SAS with no managed device while the user is concurrently active on AS-AEGEAN-EDU via managed device dev-zk-01 (T1550.004 session token replay, T1078.004 cloud account misuse); F2 corroborates with impossible travel Amsterdam→Gravelines in 15 min. The password-spray claim was rejected as shared-egress background noise (204 MFA completions from 193.140.10.44 in 30 days), so it does not undermine the chain. This is a confirmed ATC requiring containment.
